record.capability: Original shared Unicode and ASCII known-length equality
assertions: Preserve original signed32 length guard and reverse Unicode/ASCII equality through the existing C/header/value owners.
Retain literal and borrowed-view results without changing original data identity, refcount or caller buffers.
gaps: Original rtl_ustr_asciil_reverseEquals_WithLength and OUString::equalsAsciiL preserve the native length-before-read guard, back-to-front unit comparison, embedded NUL, borrowed storage and literal operator behavior without new collation/normalization or bounds repair. The native probe compiles complete unchanged original equality and lifetime scopes with genuine full OUString headers, verifies31 full pinned blobs, captures every8,388,608 UTF16/ASCII pair through both C/member owners (16,777,216 bytes SHA5780cb29bd8009a2b1044d5b5f6666b2be0b6ed56b871e89c03551ee250fc0a5) and337 complete prefix/offset/null-zero/literal/borrowed identity/refcount/input-buffer observations. Actual ASan/UBSan outputs agree; the original negative-length SIGABRT is captured separately. Uint8Array adapts borrowed constchar bytes, signed32 input conversion and signed8-to-unsigned16 conversion retain the selected signed-char target. Original ASCII0..127 caller precondition remains; diagnostic logging, non-ASCII byte warnings, unsigned-char platforms, invalid storage/physical ABI and complete original QA remain unverified. This is the actual langIs literal-equality dependency, not a Locale/UNO/casefolding service substitute. Native generated Locale/default UNO exceptions and full getValue/getConditionalValue/CharClass/SharedStringPool/Calc document/edit/UI are still incomplete.
